details.name: Determining the Weather Condition (Case 1)
details.description: Construct a program that determines whether it is both too hot and too dry based on the inputs that it receives from the user.

details.name: Determining the Weather Condition (Case 2)
details.description: Construct a program that determines whether it is either too hot or too dry (or both) based on the inputs that it receives from the user.

details.name: Determining the Weather Condition (Case 3)
details.description: Construct a program that determines whether it is too hot but not too dry based on the inputs that it receives from the user.

details.name: Determining the Weather Condition (Case 4)
details.description: Construct a program that determines whether it is either too hot or too dry but not both based on the inputs that it receives from the user.
